name: Learn to Fly Course, Private Pilot Ground School
summary: Online ground school with test prep and an endorsement, and a pass guarantee that covers the checkride too.
accessTerm: Free lifetime updates; the page does not state how long course access lasts
endorsementNote: Says that on completion you receive an official endorsement to take your FAA written test.
guarantee: Says "We guarantee that you'll pass all three tests required to get your Private Pilot certificate (FAA knowledge test, checkride oral and checkride flight) or you're entitled to a full refund."
includes: Interactive written test prep with 1,000+ questions
Custom study sessions with instructor explanations
watchOut: The guarantee covers three tests, not only the written test. Read its conditions before relying on it.
Access length is not stated on the page; one comparison article says 3 years, another says lifetime.
